bullets.text: Russia-Ukraine talks focused on post-war security concluded in Abu Dhabi without a breakthrough, with US envoys scheduled to meet both Putin and Zelensky.
A leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 190 children and one adult, after followers were instructed to starve themselves and their families.
Lewis Hamilton visited the Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip to meet with officials and tour aid facilities operated by the Egyptian Red Crescent.
The discovery of One Nation's 'missing' aircraft in an outback city may raise questions for the party regarding the handling of proceeds from its sale.
A shortage of the Q fever vaccine is impacting rural Australia, raising health concerns as the vaccine protecting against a serious bacterial infection is expected to run out this week.
Prime Minister Albanese has defended Australia's position as a climate leader after being urged by the UN Secretary-General to increase climate commitments.

US tech stocks are experiencing a surge, with the Nasdaq recovering losses, fueled by strong CoreWeave results and the prospect of a higher valuation for Anthropic's IPO, indicating a revival in the AI trade.
Crunch Fitness is seeking to borrow $800 million through an ABS bond sale backed by franchise revenue, joining other companies utilizing the whole-business securitization market.
H&R Real Estate Investment Trust's $4.7 billion breakup plan is facing significant opposition from major investors, including some of the world's largest pension funds.
